0022600006.text: The 76ers, who are 1-0 and sit 1st in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, host the Cleveland Cavaliers in Philadelphia's second game of the season and Cleveland's first. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps). The teams last met on March 9, 2026, when Philadelphia lost 115-101 in Cleveland, and the 76ers lost 0-4 to the Cavaliers in the 2025-26 season series, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
